rule: Hunted nightmoths flee to dimmer lights
texts: When a sky-cat hunts at a lantern-row, each nightmoth that survives the hunt flees to a dim lantern.
Whenever a sky-cat hunts at a lantern-row, the nightmoths that survive the hunt move to the Hollows.
When a nightmoth flees and reaches the Hollows, the lanterns at the Hollows gain silken threads.

fields.sentence: When a sky-cat hunts at a lantern-row, each nightmoth that survives the hunt flees to a dim lantern.
parse: (: skycat_hunt_flee_rule (Implication (And (Member $hunt hunt) (Agent $hunt $skycat) (Member $skycat sky_cat) (Location $hunt $lrow) (Member $lrow lantern_row) (Member $survive survive) (Agent $survive $moth) (Member $moth nightmoth) (Theme $survive $hunt)) (And (Member (sk_flee $hunt $moth) flee) (Agent (sk_flee $hunt $moth) $moth) (Goal (sk_flee $hunt $moth) (sk_lantern $hunt $moth)) (Member (sk_lantern $hunt $moth) lantern) (Member (sk_lantern $hunt $moth) dim) (During (sk_flee $hunt $moth) $hunt))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: The relative clause is correctly folded into the premises, the dependent lantern is a Skolem function of both universals, "each" gets its QuantifierPhrase companion at strength 1.0, and "dim" stays a separate descriptive Member atom rather than fusing into a compound kind.

fields.sentence: Whenever a sky-cat hunts at a lantern-row, the nightmoths that survive the hunt move to the Hollows.
parse: (: whenever_hunt_survivors_move (Implication (And (Member $e hunt) (Agent $e $s) (Member $s sky_cat) (Location $e $r) (Member $r lantern_row) (Member $m nightmoth) (Member $sv survive) (Agent $sv $m) (Theme $sv $e)) (And (Member (sk_move $m) move) (Agent (sk_move $m) $m) (Goal (sk_move $m) hollows) (During (sk_move $m) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The consequent's Skolem event `(sk_move $m)` is a function of the moth alone, but the occurrence variable `$e` also scopes over it, so one moth surviving two hunts collapses into a single move event carrying two `During` links — the instruction set requires a dependent existential to be a Skolem function of every universal that scopes over it.

review.notes: Everything else checks out: the capitalized-plural "the Hollows" correctly gets a `Name`-only individual with no `GroupOf` and no invented kind atom, the restrictive relative sits in the premises with the hunt bound by coreference to `$e`, and the animate mover keeps `Agent` rather than the un-powered-relocation `Theme`.

issues.reason: The whenever machinery mints the response 'as a Skolem event per occurrence' and a dependent existential must be a Skolem function of every universal scoping over it, so `(sk_move $m)` — indexed by the moth alone — merges the moves one moth makes after distinct hunts into a single event carrying several `During` links, asserting one move the text does not state.

new_gaps: a definite plural with a restrictive relative that co-varies with the trigger inside a whenever-rule ('the nightmoths that survive the hunt'): the definite-plural doctrine (group witness) has no rule-internal form, so the parse's per-member variable range is an unlegislated improvisation
adjudication.defect_summary: The move event must be Skolemized on the trigger occurrence as well as the moth — at minimum `(sk_move $m $e)` — with its `Member`/`Agent`/`Goal`/`During` atoms rebuilt on that term; the rest of the rule stands.
adjudication.notes: The Name-only 'the Hollows', the sky-cat/lantern-row/nightmoth genus atoms, the relative clause in the premises with 'the hunt' bound to `$e`, and `Agent` for the self-powered moth are all correct.

fields.sentence: When a nightmoth flees and reaches the Hollows, the lanterns at the Hollows gain silken threads.
parse: (: whenever_flee_gain (Implication (And (Member $x nightmoth) (Member $e1 flee) (Agent $e1 $x) (Member $e2 reach) (Agent $e2 $x) (Theme $e2 hollows)) (And (Member (sk_gain $x) gain) (Agent (sk_gain $x) sk_lantern_1) (Theme (sk_gain $x) silken_thread) (During (sk_gain $x) $e2))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The consequent's Skolem event (sk_gain $x) is a function of the nightmoth rather than of the trigger occurrence ($e1/$e2), so repeated flee-and-reach events by one moth collapse into a single gain event instead of the per-occurrence event the whenever pattern (and the dependent-existential rule) requires.

q2_gaps: a definite plural group as the subject of a distributive predicate inside a rule CONSEQUENT ('the lanterns ... gain silken threads') - the group-event-plus-per-member-distribution rule is stated only for top-level clauses, and nothing says how, or whether, to nest that distribution inside an Implication
review.notes: Name-only handling of the capitalized plural 'the Hollows', the silken_thread fusion with its material-adjective modifier genus, and the whenever-rule routing of bare 'when' with an indefinite participant all follow the instruction set.

issues.reason: The whenever rule mints the response as a Skolem event PER OCCURRENCE (its example keys (sk_bark $x) on the ring event) and the scope rule makes a dependent existential a function of every universal scoping over it, so (sk_gain $x) keyed on the moth alone collapses repeated flee-and-reach occurrences by one moth into a single gain event carrying several During anchors.

gaps_confirmed: a definite plural group ('the lanterns') as subject of a distributive predicate inside a rule consequent: the group-event-plus-per-member-rule pairing is stated for top-level clauses only, with no word on nesting or hoisting that distribution inside an Implication
new_gaps: a bare-plural object inside a rule consequent ('gain silken threads'): the bare-plural-object rule splits episodic (group witness) from kind-level (bare kind filler) only for top-level clauses and says nothing about whether a per-occurrence consequent takes a Skolem-function group or the bare kind
a coordinated trigger clause ('flees and reaches') under whenever: nothing says which trigger event the consequent's During anchors on, or whether the Skolem event takes both occurrence variables
adjudication.defect_summary: Issue 0: mint the gain per occurrence — (sk_gain $e2) (or of every premise universal, (sk_gain $x $e1 $e2)) with (During (sk_gain …) $e2), exactly as the whenever example keys (sk_bark $x) on the ring event; every other atom stands as emitted.
adjudication.notes: The Name-only 'the Hollows', LocatedIn on the definite lantern group, the nightmoth and silken_thread decompositions, and the whenever routing of bare 'when' with an indefinite trigger participant all follow the instruction set.
